Sharing the piece if you haven't read it yet and have questions about it. 

ms.now/opinion/cesar-chavez-…
Thank you to all who read my words at @MSNOWNews the last few days. As an opinion writer, it's all about those who read you. Gracias.
I think I have outgrown #MarchMadness. Get off my lawn. 😂

Just thinking about earlier this March at @wbcbaseball in Puerto Rico.  The @LatNewsletter team spent a great weekend recording for our upcoming AMERICAN COLONY podcast (July 4 premiere). Thank you to @MCollazo215 for making it happen for us to be there.

Wilyer Abreu is so damn likable. Credit to him for all the work he’s done to do these interviews in English. I think 2026 is going to be a really special season for him.

Video

Looks like Trump wants Venezuela to become the 51st of the Union all because of a baseball game. Will forever wonder now what he would have said if Puerto Rico were playing the US team in the WBC final. Baseball is not apolitical. It's always political.
